content:
Creates a copy of an existing profile. The type of profile to clone depends on the sensor_type
path parameter, which can be set to either agent  or scanners .
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "agent"
"scanners"
The type of sensor. Use agent  for agent profiles or scanners  for
scanner profiles.
string <uuid>
The unique identifier (UUID) of the profile.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
A name for the profile.
string
A short description explaining the purpose or targets of the profile.
